ideas.details: Revamp category terminology across supernatural powers and rituals into a normalized 12-Discipline '-mancy' taxonomy: Hemomancy (Blood Magic), Necromancy (Death/Soul), Osteomancy (Bone Arts), Pyromancy (Fire/Hellfire), Gravimancy (Gravity/Force Shields), Astromancy (Spatial Folding/Teleportation), Umbramancy (Shadow Traversal), Psychomancy (Mind/Illusion/Psychokinesis), Cognimancy (Perception/FLIR/Bio-Sonar), Morphomancy (Form Shifting/Swarms), Immunomancy (Bane Protection/Solar Shields), Biomancy (Healing/Vital Control). All power/ritual names, types, and descriptions normalized per user approval. Key locked terms: Spider's Grace, Daywalker's Grace, Sanguine Knit, Resounding Beat, and body-shifting in Morphomancy.
ideas.resolution: Fully implemented across framework via TODO-85 through TODO-90. Codified Section 7 in 2608/terminology.md, refactored 2608/vampire.md power section into the 12 canonical -mancy headers with [Behavioral] / [Supernatural] classification tags, added Osteomancy & Astromancy powers/rituals, updated supplements/bloodline_magic.md, and audited all anchor cross-references.

ideas.details: Direct Line-Level Micro-Anchoring: Insert invisible HTML line-level micro-anchors (``) into every individual power, ritual, protocol, law, and weapon across vampire.md, bloodline_magic.md, coven_law_protocols.md, and uv_arsenal_handbook.md. This enables 100% precise, line-level anchor linking (`[Power Name](vampire.md#power-name)`) without altering markdown bullet styling, breaking PDF 2-column page rendering, or polluting PDF bookmark drawers. All cross-references updated to point directly to micro-anchors.
